items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: They called him Sauerkraut, but his name was M.J. Collins. He's supposed to be in Chicago somewhere. He quit playing several years ago.

ctx.x: They called him Sauerkraut, but his name was M.J. Collins. He's supposed to be in Chicago somewhere. He quit playing several years ago.
The only names I know on alto at around that time are people like Stump Evans, who was a Chicago man.....
